Across the middle stands a long counter faced with glossy muted teal rectangular tiles, white grout, pale countertop, and wooden edging. Three tall sage-green wire stools line its right half. Cups, jars, coffee equipment, stacked paper cups, and a small blue-lit screen crowd the countertop; a dark-haired worker stands behind its right end. An open black metal overhead rack carries dishes and plants. Amber pendant bulbs hang on long black cords, with smaller woven basket shades farther back. The high white corrugated ceiling exposes beams, ducts, cables, and track lights. Warm olive-yellow walls surround a pale blue door at left and a large botanical-patterned opening at right, bordered in wood. Two leaning wooden merchandise shelves occupy the right wall. Tiny signs remain unreadable. Tan polished concrete flooring, soft daylight from the right, warm pendant pools, natural colors, deep focus, slight wide-angle distortion.
